decisions.reason: As an online shop design template closely tied to the firm's existing Magento hosting and web project knowledge, it is well understood and can be improved using existing capabilities.
A responsive website template builds directly on the firm's established web hosting and CMS services, so the firm can assimilate feedback and refine it with its current technical knowledge.
Premium customer support is a natural extension of the firm's core service and support operations, giving it high absorptive capacity to interpret results and enhance the offer.

The software version management tool extends the firm's existing management tools and technical know-how, so although somewhat more complex, it remains within the firm's capacity to learn and improve.

An online tool for data processing contracts is distant from the firm's hosting and technical service knowledge, limiting its ability to assimilate feedback and develop the product further, making withdrawal likely.
